title: The kb MCP server's set, move, reopen and drop tools change an item with the CLI's own scope and status refusals
goal: With KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 the kb MCP server lists backlog_set (the options of backlog.py set as typed arguments, the option's dashes as underscores, list options as arrays, clear as an array, by only for delegate and owner), backlog_move (id, sprint), backlog_reopen (id, why) and backlog_drop (id, why), each run in-process like the claim tool; the item files a call writes are byte-identical to the same command line run through backlog.py on a copy, an argument the CLI's set refuses (status, claimed_by, evidence, a done item's goal) is a tool error that writes nothing, reopen of an item that is not done and an unknown argument are tool errors, and set takes no root

run: import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,shutil,json,glob;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS"]="1";[os.environ.pop(k,None) for k in ("CLAUDECODE","CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION")];import kb_mcp;R=os.getcwd();a=tempfile.mkdtemp();b=a+"-twin";g=lambda *x:subprocess.run(["git","-C",a,*x],check=True,capture_output=True);g("init","-q");g("config","user.email","a@example.com");g("config","user.name","n");cli=lambda r,*x:subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",r,*x],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDECODE="1"));iid=cli(a,"new","story","--title","Planted","--goal","g","--touch","x/*","--check","true").stdout.split()[2];g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","plant");shutil.copytree(a,b);call=lambda n,**k:kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":n,"arguments":k}})["result"];files=lambda r:[open(f).read() for f in sorted(glob.glob(r+"/_backlog/*.json"))];c1=cli(a,"set",iid,"--priority","P1","--add-notes","n");os.chdir(b);t1=call("backlog_set",id=iid,priority="P1",add_notes=["n"]);assert (c1.returncode==0)==(not t1["isError"]),("set parity",c1.returncode,t1);assert files(a)==files(b),"set wrote different item files";before=files(b);bad=[call("backlog_set",id=iid,status="done"),call("backlog_reopen",id=iid,why="x"),call("backlog_set",id=iid,root="/tmp")];assert all(x["isError"] for x in bad),bad;assert files(b)==before,"a refused call wrote";d1=cli(a,"drop",iid,"--why","dup");d2=call("backlog_drop",id=iid,why="dup");assert (d1.returncode==0)==(not d2["isError"]),("drop parity",d1,d2);assert files(a)==files(b),"drop wrote different item files"

notes: Evidence 2026-11-08. Census of 229 main-checkout transcripts: set 1845 Bash calls (69 errors), new 1082 (36), drop 61 (5), move 46 (6), reopen 5; none through MCP. set's refusals live in the CLI (backlog.py usage block 'set': status, claimed_by, evidence, id, kind and a done item's goal, repro, checks and touches refused with exit 2; a batch refuses --title, --goal, --notes), so the tool runs the CLI in-process and adds no rule of its own. Choices: set is one tool with a typed argument for each option, because the options are one parser; one id per call, so each result names one item; drop of an item outside a sprint deletes its file (git keeps it), so its annotation is destructive in the annotation table of ST-lpkde2s3. Inline, no pairing with the service.
